notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.notes:
Thank you!
A big thank you to those who have completed the feedback form, or joined the Discord and given constructive feedback - it really helps shape the future of Decaying Salvage.  I'm especially thankful to those that have acknowledged the premise of this demo, a prototype aimed to shape the game. You're awesome and I couldn't imagine doing it without you.



Join the Discord: Join The Discord




Patch Notes
Alright, what's in the patch?

Enemies now pause when interacting with certain puzzles.

Enemies have more consistent health without randomisation (who knew people wouldn't like that?!)

The barrier to the maintenance corridor now gives players more of a clue it can be entered.

Invisible enemies should THIS time no longer exist - thanks MisFitPit ;)

A few save/load logic things have been fixed

Fixed a few camera triggers

Removed a few instances where the player could walk off camera


Don't forget ...
Join the Discord: Join The Discord



-Drewid.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1
notes.notes:
Off to a Good Start!
First of all, a big thank you to the over 600 people who have downloaded the demo! That's an awesome start and lets me know people are seeing the game!


Feedback
Feedback is extremely important, especially for a game doing early prototype testing. I'm listening, and making changes, which is why the first patch is already available. So please keep the reports coming, and the feedback on the demo coming. You can do them here:

Join the Discord: Join The Discord

Give some Feedback: Open the Feedback Form


Patch Notes
Now for the important stuff, what is in this patch:

Player can now move (and aim) using the right stick! 

Fixed a few camera transitions that clipped through the world (wasn't breaking the game, but breaking immersion)

Fast enemies have been slowed down a little. They were causing potential soft locks as they moved at the same speed as the player.

Player animation speeds have been tweaked a little to improve the feel of the character movement. A major overhaul will be coming later. 

Sometimes, an invisible enemy will be in a very specific room. I think I've tracked down the offender, and put him in quarantine. Let's hope he doesn't break loose.

Added a note to the control rebinding screen that explains rebinding a control will not currently update the in-game tutorials.

Player had a tendency, in rare circumstances, to get stuck in a permanent squat and slide around the environment. While I commend Jordan's workout routing allowing her to do that, it should now be fixed.


Patch Plans
There are some larger issues, that while not game breaking do need to be addressed. But hey, that's the whole point of a prototype demo! These include:

Making more changes to the player animation system. 

Enhancing the stun system for the enemies. 

Much more (let me know stuff!)


The Competition
The Demo also includes a "1998" mode, which if you beat within 12 minutes, and are one of the first 5, you'll win a free copy of the full game. 

There is already ONE winner :O So get running!



Join the Discord: Join The Discord

Give some Feedback: Open the Feedback Form


Thank you!
Thank you again for playing, interacting, wishlisting and just being here, you mean a lot to me and with your help I feel Decaying Salvage can become something awesome.



-Drewid.
